entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, [fName]-kun... Do you remember[n]the magic item I mentioned before?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The thing that will help me[n]show Takakura-san how I really[n]feel... is right here.
The soil?[clr 27]
The planters?
This beetle?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* Correct!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Nope! It's what's inside the planters[n]that counts!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, wow! That one is huge![n]But that's not exactly it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You see, the soil here is a special mix[n]I made with a few different kinds of[n]fertilizer. It's very high quality.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's soft, it's warm, it has good drainage...[n]and it's full of nutrients.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This... This is the magic I need.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm not very good at expressing[n]myself with words... Just thinking[n]about it makes my heart race...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I've been pouring my heart and[n]soul into this soil for months now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It knows exactly how I feel.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's why I'm going to use[n]it to grow my coffee plants.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then once they're ready, I'm going[n]to make coffee with the beans! It[n]shouldn't be much longer now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Honestly... just raising those plants[n]has taken considerable effort.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've checked on them every day, given[n]them water, put them in the sun...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But... all of that love and care has[n]found its way into the beans themselves.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Combining that with the nurturing[n]warmth of this soil should give me[n]the perfect way to convey how I feel.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder what Takakura-san[n]will think when he tries it...
It'll help him understand you.[clr 27]
He's going to love it.[clr 27]
He might not like it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes! I fully believe in that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* It's strange... Only[n]recently, I was struggling to[n]find belief in anything.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* I hope you're right.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm not particularly confident[n]in the flavor though... After all,[n]this is my first attempt.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* I'm certain he won't.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I mean, I would probably need[n]to spend some time on a farm if[n]I wanted to grow coffee properly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: By the way, I've thought about it some[n]more, and... I wouldn't necessarily be[n]opposed to Takakura-san's idea.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If that's what management decides[n]to do, I won't get in their way.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: At the same time, I can't support them[n]if their main goal is to deceive.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What I mean is, people don't think of[n]Okumura Foods very highly right now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So... I'm afraid management is trying[n]to use this new chain to sneak under the[n]radar rather than rebuild our image.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Of course, I understand how hard it is[n]to rid yourself of a negative label...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But if they want to fool people with a[n]low-quality product instead of regaining[n]their trust... I will proudly oppose them.
I'll be cheering for you.
You're amazing, Haru.[clr 27]
Are you sure you can do that?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* Thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* Well, naturally. I'm a[n]heroine of justice, after all.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Just kidding.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I am. I'll fight back, even if[n]they try to brush me aside.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You know, [fName]-kun... it's[n]so reassuring having you here.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's because of you that I was[n]able to cultivate this soil...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And because of you that I have the[n]courage to tell Takakura-san how I feel.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Speaking of which, um... do you think[n]you could be there when I do it?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: As long as you're with me, I won't[n]be afraid to say what I'm thinking.
I can sense an earnest[n]resolve from Haru...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now then, I need to take some of[n]this soil home to my coffee plants.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Could you carry a bag for me?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, see you later.
